name: Jean McHatton
office: Abc Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5 (Unexpired term ending December 8, 2028)

items.text: Jean McHatton was appointed in April 2025 to the ABC Unified School District Board in Trustee Area 5 to fill a vacancy. She is running to keep the seat, and her campaign says she spent 40 years in public education as a classroom teacher, elementary principal and district curriculum director. Her campaign also says she currently mentors new teachers and administrators. On the board, she was part of a 4-3 majority that voted to halt a plan to close several elementary schools and reconfigure a high school.
